tgt: Dimulai setidaknya pada tahun 1979, awalnya merupakan bagian dari acara tengah pagi-nya di BBC Radio 1, di mana acara tersebut ditayangkan setiap hari sepanjang tahun 1980-an dan awal 1990-an.

src: Having existed continuously since 1590, Berenberg Bank is the world's oldest surviving merchant bank.
tgt: Telah ada secara berkelanjutan sejak 1590, Berenberg Bank adalah bank pedagang tertua yang masih bertahan di dunia.

src: Hawaii Five-0 (2010 TV series)
tgt: Hawaii Five-0 (serial TV 2010)

src: Hawaii Five-0 is an American action police procedural television series, which premiered on Monday, September 20, 2010 on CBS.
tgt: Hawaii Five-0 adalah serial televisi prosedural polisi aksi Amerika, yang tayang perdana pada hari Senin, 20 September 2010 di CBS.

src: Hawaii House of Representatives
tgt: Dewan Perwakilan Rakyat Hawaii

src: Hawaii Senate
tgt: Senat Hawaii

src: Hawaii State Legislature
tgt: Legislatif Negara Bagian Hawaii

src: Hawaii's Story by Hawaii's Queen
tgt: Kisah Hawaii oleh Ratu Hawaii

src: Hayley Nichole Williams (born December 27, 1988) is an American singer, songwriter and musician.
tgt: Hayley Nichole Williams (lahir 27 Desember 1988) adalah penyanyi, penulis lagu, dan musisi Amerika.

src: Hayley Williams
tgt: Hayley Williams

src: He achieved success at the Edinburgh Festival Fringe and as a scriptwriter and performer on "The Frost Report".
tgt: Dia meraih kesuksesan di Edinburgh Festival Fringe dan sebagai penulis naskah serta pemain di "The Frost Report".

src: He also appeared in the final episode of the web-series "Saturday Morning Car-Tunez", created by Andy Mineo, where he helped remix the Puff Daddy song "It's All About the Benjamins".
tgt: Dia juga tampil di episode terakhir serial web "Saturday Morning Car-Tunez", yang dibuat oleh Andy Mineo, di mana dia membantu me-remix lagu Puff Daddy "It's All About the Benjamins".

src: He also embarked on a solo career in 1997, when he released the album "American Lesion".
tgt: Dia juga memulai karier solo pada tahun 1997, ketika ia merilis album "American Lesion".

src: He also lived and wrote in New York City for 31 years.
tgt: Dia juga tinggal dan menulis di New York City selama 31 tahun.

src: He also took part in TV events, which includes ESPN's "Alumni Beach Bowl", ABC's "Battle of the Gridiron" and the Special Olympics.
tgt: Dia juga berpartisipasi dalam acara TV, termasuk "Alumni Beach Bowl" ESPN, "Battle of the Gridiron" ABC, dan Special Olympics.

src: He also won the Tony Award and 2008 Outer Critics Circle Award, and was nominated for a Drama Desk Award for "American Idiot" and "Everyday Rapture".
tgt: Dia juga memenangkan Tony Award dan Outer Critics Circle Award 2008, dan dinominasikan untuk Drama Desk Award untuk "American Idiot" dan "Everyday Rapture".

src: He and his younger brother Harold Nicholas made up the Nicholas Brothers tap-dance duo, who starred in the MGM musicals "An All-Colored Vaudeville Show" (1935), "Stormy Weather" (1943), "The Pirate" (1948), and "Hard Four" (2007).
tgt: Dia dan adik laki-lakinya, Harold Nicholas, membentuk duo tap-dance Nicholas Brothers, yang membintangi musikal MGM "An All-Colored Vaudeville Show" (1935), "Stormy Weather" (1943), "The Pirate" (1948), dan "Hard Four" (2007).

src: He appears in early video footage of AC/DC, the "Last Picture Show Theatre" video of "Can I Sit Next to You Girl".
tgt: Dia muncul dalam rekaman video awal AC/DC, video "Last Picture Show Theatre" dari "Can I Sit Next to You Girl".

src: He assumed by Royal licence the additional surname of Aubrey on succeeding to the title in 1910.
tgt: Ia mengambil nama keluarga tambahan Aubrey berdasarkan lisensi Kerajaan setelah mewarisi gelar tersebut pada tahun 1910.

src: He became the King Zheng of Qin (秦王政 ) when he was thirteen, then China's first emperor when he was 38 after the Qin had conquered all of the other Warring States and unified all of China in 221 BC.
tgt: Ia menjadi Raja Zheng dari Qin (秦王政) ketika berusia tiga belas tahun, kemudian kaisar pertama Tiongkok ketika berusia 38 tahun setelah Qin menaklukkan semua Negara Berperang lainnya dan menyatukan seluruh Tiongkok pada tahun 221 SM.

src: He became the first from Pakistan to have climbed Everest on 17 May 2000 as a team member on the Mountain Madness Everest Expedition led by Christine Boskoff from USA that also included famed Everest climber Peter Habeler of Austria and eight Canadians.
tgt: Dia menjadi orang pertama dari Pakistan yang mendaki Everest pada 17 Mei 2000 sebagai anggota tim dalam Ekspedisi Everest Mountain Madness yang dipimpin oleh Christine Boskoff dari USA yang juga mencakup pendaki Everest terkenal Peter Habeler dari Austria dan delapan orang Kanada.

src: He began ending towards the end of the silent era of the film industry, his first film being 1927's "The College Hero", directed by Walter Lang.
tgt: Ia mulai mengakhiri menjelang akhir era bisu industri film, film pertamanya adalah "The College Hero" tahun 1927, yang disutradarai oleh Walter Lang.

src: He began his film career by starring as Josh in "Critters 3" (1991).
tgt: Ia memulai karier filmnya dengan berperan sebagai Josh di "Critters 3" (1991).

src: He came from a working-class background and left school when he was twelve to start his working life sweeping floors in Stoneywood Paper Mill; his education was continued by attending evening classes and he gained several qualifications as his early career progressed.
tgt: Ia berasal dari latar belakang kelas pekerja dan meninggalkan sekolah ketika berusia dua belas tahun untuk memulai kehidupan kerjanya dengan menyapu lantai di Stoneywood Paper Mill; pendidikannya dilanjutkan dengan menghadiri kelas malam dan ia memperoleh beberapa kualifikasi seiring kemajuan karier awalnya.

src: He did not renew his party membership in 2007.
tgt: Dia tidak memperpanjang keanggotaan partainya pada tahun 2007.

src: He died due to cancer on 21 November 2016 in Rawalpindi.
tgt: Dia meninggal karena kanker pada 21 November 2016 di Rawalpindi.

src: He died in his home town of Stratford on 23 April 1616 at the age of 52.
tgt: Dia meninggal di kota kelahirannya, Stratford, pada 23 April 1616 pada usia 52 tahun.

src: He founded Hong Kong Reporter in 2004, an internet radio station focused on live talk radio broadcasting.
tgt: Dia mendirikan Hong Kong Reporter pada tahun 2004, sebuah stasiun radio internet yang berfokus pada siaran radio obrolan langsung.

src: He gained notoriety after being captured by South Vietnamese forces while trying to assassinate United States Secretary of Defense Robert McNamara and future ambassador Henry Cabot Lodge Jr. who were visiting South Vietnam in May 1963.
tgt: Dia menjadi terkenal setelah ditangkap oleh pasukan Vietnam Selatan saat mencoba membunuh Menteri Pertahanan Amerika Serikat Robert McNamara dan calon duta besar Henry Cabot Lodge Jr. yang sedang mengunjungi Vietnam Selatan pada Mei 1963.

src: He garnered critical acclaim for his role as Myron in the 1984 film "The Hit" (1984), for which he was nominated for his first BAFTA Award.
tgt: Dia menuai pujian kritis atas perannya sebagai Myron dalam film "The Hit" (1984), untuk peran tersebut ia dinominasikan untuk BAFTA Award pertamanya.

src: He had a renowned backhand and enjoyed a long career at the highest levels from the early 1950s to the early 1970s.
tgt: Dia memiliki pukulan *backhand* yang terkenal dan menikmati karier panjang di level tertinggi dari awal 1950-an hingga awal 1970-an.

src: He has also acted in the films "The Benchwarmers", "School for Scoundrels", "Blades of Glory", "Mama's Boy", "When in Rome", and "Walt Before Mickey" as Roy Disney, and provided voice talents in the animated films "Monster House" and "Surf's Up", as well as the "Napoleon Dynamite" animated series.
tgt: Dia juga telah membintangi film-film "The Benchwarmers", "School for Scoundrels", "Blades of Glory", "Mama's Boy", "When in Rome", dan "Walt Before Mickey" sebagai Roy Disney, dan memberikan suara dalam film animasi "Monster House" dan "Surf's Up", serta serial animasi "Napoleon Dynamite".

src: He has also made some documentaries in several international locations, including during times of war.
tgt: Dia juga telah membuat beberapa film dokumenter di berbagai lokasi internasional, termasuk selama masa perang.

src: He has also released one music video album and over 60 music videos, the details of which are included in his videography.
tgt: Dia juga telah merilis satu album video musik dan lebih dari 60 video musik, rinciannya termasuk dalam videografinya.

src: He has also represented Germany in youth competitions.
tgt: Dia juga telah mewakili Jerman dalam kompetisi usia muda.

src: He has appeared in Academy Award-winning films, such as "Dances with Wolves" (1990) and "The Last of the Mohicans" (1992), and in the Academy Award-nominated films "" (1993) and "The New World" (2005).
tgt: Dia telah tampil dalam film pemenang Academy Award, seperti "Dances with Wolves" (1990) dan "The Last of the Mohicans" (1992), dan dalam film yang dinominasikan Academy Award "" (1993) dan "The New World" (2005).

src: He has been described by "Time" as "one of the most influential operatives in the Democratic Party".
tgt: Dia telah digambarkan oleh "Time" sebagai "salah satu operator paling berpengaruh di Partai Demokrat".

src: He has been nominated for 6 Grammys, has won 3 Grammy Awards and is currently nominated for an Emmy Award.
tgt: Dia telah dinominasikan untuk 6 Grammy, telah memenangkan 3 Grammy Awards, dan saat ini dinominasikan untuk Emmy Award.

src: He has been the lead vocalist for the bands Dance Gavin Dance, Emarosa, Ghost Runner on Third, Slaves, and westerHALTS.
tgt: Dia telah menjadi vokalis utama untuk band Dance Gavin Dance, Emarosa, Ghost Runner on Third, Slaves, dan westerHALTS.

src: He has done work translating, adapting, and implementing sports training methodology from the former Soviet Union, including work by Yuri Verkhoshansky, Anatoliy Bondarchuk, and Vladimir Issurin, for over fifty years.
tgt: Dia telah melakukan pekerjaan menerjemahkan, mengadaptasi, dan mengimplementasikan metodologi pelatihan olahraga dari bekas Uni Soviet, termasuk karya Yuri Verkhoshansky, Anatoliy Bondarchuk, dan Vladimir Issurin, selama lebih dari lima puluh tahun.

src: He has performed and recorded with English rock band The Who since 1996.
tgt: Dia telah tampil dan merekam bersama band rock Inggris The Who sejak tahun 1996.

src: He has performed with and alongside Taj Mahal for over forty years.
tgt: Dia telah tampil bersama dan di samping Taj Mahal selama lebih dari empat puluh tahun.

src: He has recently been cast in the 1920s crime film "Live By Night" as Paulo Bartolo alongside Ben Affleck and Chris Messina.
tgt: Dia baru-baru ini mendapat peran dalam film kriminal tahun 1920-an "Live By Night" sebagai Paulo Bartolo bersama Ben Affleck dan Chris Messina.

src: He has released 12 studio albums and 44 singles since 1992, and is best known for his number one single "Achy Breaky Heart", which became the first single ever to achieve triple Platinum status in Australia and was the best-selling single of 1992 in the same country.
tgt: Dia telah merilis 12 album studio dan 44 single sejak tahun 1992, dan paling dikenal karena single nomor satunya "Achy Breaky Heart", yang menjadi single pertama yang mencapai status Triple Platinum di Australia dan merupakan single terlaris tahun 1992 di negara yang sama.

src: He has since gained more notability for playing the roles on "", Father Ray Mukada on "Oz", Dr. John Lee on "Awake", Dr. Henry Wu in the first "Jurassic Park" film as well as the fourth entry, "Jurassic World", and Ngapoi Ngawang Jigme in the film "Seven Years in Tibet".
tgt: Sejak saat itu ia semakin terkenal karena memerankan peran-peran dalam "", Father Ray Mukada di "Oz", Dr. John Lee di "Awake", Dr. Henry Wu di film "Jurassic Park" pertama maupun entri keempat, "Jurassic World", dan Ngapoi Ngawang Jigme di film "Seven Years in Tibet".

src: He has worked with many artists, such as Sandi Patti, Steve Green, Kathy Troccoli, Michael Crawford, Glen Campbell, Carman, Larnelle Harris, Johnny Cash and Dolly Parton.
tgt: Dia telah bekerja dengan banyak artis, seperti Sandi Patti, Steve Green, Kathy Troccoli, Michael Crawford, Glen Campbell, Carman, Larnelle Harris, Johnny Cash, dan Dolly Parton.

src: He has written for "The Simpsons" and served as the head writer and executive producer of "Futurama".
tgt: Dia pernah menulis untuk "The Simpsons" dan menjabat sebagai kepala penulis serta produser eksekutif "Futurama".

src: He has written over a dozen books in the field of American Jewish history and also served as associate editor to "American Jewish History", the most important journal in that field, from 1982 to 2002.
tgt: Dia telah menulis lebih dari selusin buku di bidang sejarah Yahudi Amerika dan juga menjabat sebagai editor asosiasi untuk "American Jewish History", jurnal terpenting di bidang tersebut, dari tahun 1982 hingga 2002.

src: He is a member of the Editorial Board and the Presidential Board of "Concilium: International Journal for Theology", also an editor of the Dutch "Tijdschrift voor Theologie" and member of the Third Order of Saint Dominic.
tgt: Dia adalah anggota Dewan Editorial dan Dewan Presiden "Concilium: International Journal for Theology", juga editor "Tijdschrift voor Theologie" Belanda dan anggota Ordo Ketiga Santo Dominikus.

src: He is a member of the National Soccer Hall of Fame.
tgt: Dia adalah anggota National Soccer Hall of Fame.

src: He is also GMA-nominated contributor to the UK's Official PlayStation Magazine and unofficial PlayStation magazine PSM3, has written for Venue, and previously worked as The Boy Next Door, an agony uncle for J-17.
tgt: Dia juga merupakan kontributor yang dinominasikan GMA untuk Official PlayStation Magazine Inggris dan majalah PlayStation tidak resmi PSM3, pernah menulis untuk Venue, dan sebelumnya bekerja sebagai The Boy Next Door, seorang "agony uncle" untuk J-17.

src: He is also known for a science humor story he wrote in OMNI magazine, the Buttered cat paradox.
tgt: Dia juga dikenal karena cerita humor sains yang dia tulis di majalah OMNI, paradoks kucing mentega.

src: He is also known for directing "Night of the Demon", that was released by Columbia Pictures.
tgt: Dia juga dikenal karena menyutradarai "Night of the Demon", yang dirilis oleh Columbia Pictures.

src: He is also known for his translation work of the great Muslim authors, Al-Ghazali, a theologian who died in 1111 and Tunisian historian Ibn Khaldun (1332-1406).
tgt: Dia juga dikenal karena karya terjemahannya dari penulis Muslim besar, Al-Ghazali, seorang teolog yang meninggal pada tahun 1111, dan sejarawan Tunisia Ibn Khaldun (1332-1406).

src: He is also the author of numerous transcriptions and arrangements of guitar, piano, choral and vocal pieces.
tgt: Dia juga penulis banyak transkripsi dan aransemen karya gitar, piano, paduan suara, dan vokal.

src: He is also the founder and frontman of Trelldom and Gaahlskagg.
tgt: Dia juga pendiri dan vokalis Trelldom dan Gaahlskagg.

src: He is also the president of Aspen Institute Romania, which is an apolitical and non-profit organisation.
tgt: Dia juga presiden Aspen Institute Romania, yang merupakan organisasi nirlaba dan apolitis.

src: He is an Emeritus Professor of both the University of Wollongong and Southern Cross University.
tgt: Beliau adalah Profesor Emeritus di University of Wollongong dan Southern Cross University.

src: He is an elder brother of George Young, the rhythm guitarist and founding member of the Easybeats, as well as Malcolm and Angus Young, founding members of the Australian hard rock band AC/DC, and the younger brother of Stephen Young, the father of Stevie Young, who was also a member of AC/DC.
tgt: Dia adalah kakak laki-laki George Young, gitaris ritme dan anggota pendiri Easybeats, serta Malcolm dan Angus Young, anggota pendiri band hard rock Australia AC/DC, dan adik laki-laki Stephen Young, ayah dari Stevie Young, yang juga merupakan anggota AC/DC.

src: He is an emeritus professor at the University of Washington.
tgt: Dia adalah profesor emeritus di University of Washington.

src: He is an emeritus professor of biological science at the Institute of Molecular Biophysics, Florida State University, and an emeritus professor of biology at the Rosenstiel Basic Medical Sciences Research Center, Brandeis University.
tgt: Beliau adalah profesor emeritus ilmu biologi di Institute of Molecular Biophysics, Florida State University, dan profesor emeritus biologi di Rosenstiel Basic Medical Sciences Research Center, Brandeis University.

src: He is best known as the lead singer of the rock band Journey during their most commercially successful periods from 1977 to 1987 and again from 1995 to 1998.
tgt: Dia paling dikenal sebagai vokalis utama band rock Journey selama periode paling sukses secara komersial mereka dari tahun 1977 hingga 1987 dan lagi dari tahun 1995 hingga 1998.

src: He is best known for being co-frontman of the Libertines, which he formed with Carl Barât in 1997.
tgt: Dia paling dikenal sebagai vokalis bersama Libertines, yang dia bentuk bersama Carl Barât pada tahun 1997.

src: He is best known for his role as "Det. Ben Kokua" on the CBS television series "Hawaii Five-O" and as Mamo Kahike on the 2010 reboot of Hawaii Five-0 playing the owner of a surf shop and a bus driver in the off season.
tgt: Dia paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai "Det. Ben Kokua" di serial televisi CBS "Hawaii Five-O" dan sebagai Mamo Kahike di *reboot* Hawaii Five-0 tahun 2010, memerankan pemilik toko selancar dan sopir bus di musim sepi.

src: He is best known for his role as The Hook-Handed Man in "Lemony Snicket's A Series of Unfortunate Events", Rodney in "Rise of the Planet of the Apes" and Gordon in Marvel's "Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.".
tgt: Dia paling dikenal karena perannya sebagai The Hook-Handed Man dalam "Lemony Snicket's A Series of Unfortunate Events", Rodney dalam "Rise of the Planet of the Apes", dan Gordon dalam Marvel's "Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.".

src: He is best known to the Telugu audience as "Appaji" from Amrutham popular TV show.
tgt: Dia paling dikenal oleh penonton Telugu sebagai "Appaji" dari acara TV populer Amrutham.

src: He is co-founder of the animation studio Klasky Csupo, which has produced shows like "Rugrats", "Duckman", and "Aaahh!!!
tgt: Dia adalah salah satu pendiri studio animasi Klasky Csupo, yang telah memproduksi acara seperti "Rugrats", "Duckman", dan "Aaahh!!!".

src: He is considered the "Apostle to the English" and a founder of the Catholic Church in England.
tgt: Dia dianggap sebagai "Rasul Inggris" dan pendiri Gereja Katolik di Inggris.

src: He is credited with writing episodes of the American television series, "Lost".
tgt: Ia dikreditkan menulis episode serial televisi Amerika, "Lost".

src: He is currently the opinion editor of "The Washington Times", Fox News contributor, Breitbart News contributor, and a Drudge Report editor.
tgt: Saat ini ia adalah editor opini "The Washington Times", kontributor Fox News, kontributor Breitbart News, dan editor Drudge Report.

src: He is currently the vocalist in INVSN.
tgt: Dia saat ini adalah vokalis di INVSN.

src: He is known as the voice of The Beast in the Disney animated film "Beauty and the Beast" and its numerous sequels and spin-offs, and for directing several episodes of the popular sitcom "Friends".
tgt: Dia dikenal sebagai suara The Beast dalam film animasi Disney "Beauty and the Beast" dan berbagai sekuel serta spin-off-nya, dan karena menyutradarai beberapa episode sitkom populer "Friends".

src: He is known for being the lead guitarist for the heavy metal band Mötley Crüe until the band retired in 2015.
tgt: Dia dikenal sebagai gitaris utama untuk band heavy metal Mötley Crüe hingga band tersebut pensiun pada tahun 2015.

src: He is known for his long-running role as Wolverine in the "X-Men" film series, as well as for his lead roles in films such as the romantic-comedy fantasy "Kate & Leopold" (2001), the action-horror film "Van Helsing" (2004), the magic-themed drama "The Prestige" (2006), the epic fantasy drama "The Fountain" (2006), the epic historical romantic drama "Australia" (2008), the film version of "Les Misérables" (2012), and the thriller "Prisoners" (2013).
tgt: Dia dikenal karena perannya yang panjang sebagai Wolverine dalam seri film "X-Men", serta peran utamanya dalam film-film seperti komedi romantis fantasi "Kate & Leopold" (2001), film aksi-horor "Van Helsing" (2004), drama bertema sihir "The Prestige" (2006), drama fantasi epik "The Fountain" (2006), drama romantis sejarah epik "Australia" (2008), versi film "Les Misérables" (2012), dan thriller "Prisoners" (2013).

src: He is married to Debra Hicks and they have three children: Erik Martin Dilan (who represents Brooklyn in the City Council), Melissa and Nicole, and one grandchild, Daniel Martin Dilan.
tgt: Dia menikah dengan Debra Hicks dan mereka memiliki tiga anak: Erik Martin Dilan (yang mewakili Brooklyn di Dewan Kota), Melissa dan Nicole, serta satu cucu, Daniel Martin Dilan.

src: He is most notable for his critically acclaimed work with British indie rock groups such as James, Elbow and Daughter.
tgt: Dia paling terkenal karena karyanya yang mendapat pujian kritis dengan grup indie rock Inggris seperti James, Elbow, dan Daughter.

src: He is the brother of Eden and Kylian Hazard; Thorgan is the second oldest child of the family.
tgt: Dia adalah saudara dari Eden dan Kylian Hazard; Thorgan adalah anak kedua tertua dari keluarga itu.

src: He is the brother of actor/comedian David Spade.
tgt: Dia adalah saudara dari aktor/komedian David Spade.

src: He is the brother of author Peter Birro.
tgt: Dia adalah saudara dari penulis Peter Birro.

src: He is the chief executive officer of Nerdist Industries, the digital division of Legendary Entertainment.
tgt: Dia adalah chief executive officer Nerdist Industries, divisi digital dari Legendary Entertainment.

src: He is the former head coach of the Arizona State Sun Devils baseball team.
tgt: Dia adalah mantan pelatih kepala tim bisbol Arizona State Sun Devils.

src: He is the only performer to have won Olivier awards in the drama, musical and comedy categories.
tgt: Dia adalah satu-satunya penampil yang memenangkan penghargaan Olivier di kategori drama, musikal, dan komedi.

src: He is the son of Corinna and seven-time Formula One World Champion Michael Schumacher, nephew of former Formula One driver Ralf Schumacher, and stepnephew of Sebastian Stahl.
tgt: Dia adalah putra Corinna dan juara dunia Formula One tujuh kali Michael Schumacher, keponakan pembalap Formula One mantan Ralf Schumacher, dan keponakan tiri Sebastian Stahl.

src: He is the twin brother of series' protagonist Solid Snake and Solidus Snake as well as the second product of the "Les Enfants Terribles", a top-secret government project to artificially create soldiers through the DNA of Big Boss.
tgt: Dia adalah saudara kembar dari protagonis seri Solid Snake dan Solidus Snake serta produk kedua dari "Les Enfants Terribles", sebuah proyek rahasia pemerintah untuk menciptakan tentara secara artifisial melalui DNA Big Boss.

src: He is the younger brother of late actor Patrick Swayze.
tgt: Dia adalah adik laki-laki aktor mendiang Patrick Swayze.

src: He is widely considered to be the founder of morphophonology.
tgt: Dia secara luas dianggap sebagai pendiri morfofonologi.

src: He lived in the little half-timbered house from the age of two until he was 14.
tgt: Dia tinggal di rumah setengah kayu kecil itu sejak usia dua tahun hingga ia berusia 14 tahun.

src: He made his ADAC Formula 4 debut in 2015, partnering Mick Schumacher, son of world champion driver Michael Schumacher, at Van Amersfoort Racing.
tgt: Ia melakukan debut ADAC Formula 4-nya pada tahun 2015, berpasangan dengan Mick Schumacher, putra pembalap juara dunia Michael Schumacher, di Van Amersfoort Racing.

src: He made his debut at age 18 music for the musical "Mirage?"
tgt: Ia membuat debut pada usia 18 tahun dengan musik untuk musikal "Mirage?"

src: He made his debut in the thirty-five point loss against Melbourne at TIO Traeger Park in round ten of the 2017 season.
tgt: Ia melakukan debutnya dalam kekalahan 35 poin melawan Melbourne di TIO Traeger Park pada putaran sepuluh musim 2017.

src: He made his opera debut in 1997 and his international career has included performances with the Metropolitan Opera.
tgt: Ia melakukan debut opera pada tahun 1997 dan karier internasionalnya mencakup penampilan dengan Metropolitan Opera.

src: He may have had a second reign from 808 until perhaps 811 or 830.
tgt: Dia mungkin memiliki pemerintahan kedua dari tahun 808 hingga mungkin tahun 811 atau 830.

src: He meets Adam, Bree, and Chase, three bionic superhumans, with whom he develops an immediate friendship.
tgt: Dia bertemu Adam, Bree, dan Chase, tiga superman bionik, dengan siapa dia mengembangkan persahabatan instan.

src: He most recently served as the head coach of the Brooklyn Nets of the National Basketball Association (NBA).
tgt: Beliau baru-baru ini menjabat sebagai kepala pelatih Brooklyn Nets dari National Basketball Association (NBA).

src: He named the character after his mother Margaret Groening.
tgt: Dia menamai karakter itu sesuai dengan ibunya, Margaret Groening.

src: He officially joined the band in September 2014, replacing his uncle, Malcolm Young who retired due to dementia.
tgt: Dia secara resmi bergabung dengan band tersebut pada September 2014, menggantikan pamannya, Malcolm Young, yang pensiun karena demensia.

src: He played Ozzie Nelson's friend and neighbor, Joe Randolph, for ten years in the ABC situation comedy "The Adventures of Ozzie and Harriet".
tgt: Dia memerankan Joe Randolph, teman dan tetangga Ozzie Nelson, selama sepuluh tahun dalam komedi situasi ABC "The Adventures of Ozzie and Harriet".

src: He played club level rugby union for Aberavon.
tgt: Dia bermain rugby union tingkat klub untuk Aberavon.

src: He played in the Dutch League for HDM and Breda.
tgt: Dia bermain di Liga Belanda untuk HDM dan Breda.

src: He played in the National Rugby League for the Melbourne Storm and North Queensland Cowboys, with whom he was a member of their 2015 NRL premiership and 2016 World Club Challenge winning sides.
tgt: Dia bermain di National Rugby League untuk Melbourne Storm dan North Queensland Cowboys, bersama mereka dia adalah anggota tim juara premiership NRL 2015 dan pemenang World Club Challenge 2016.

src: He played most of his career as a forward before converting to a central back in his final years.
tgt: Dia bermain sebagai penyerang sebagian besar kariernya sebelum beralih menjadi bek tengah di tahun-tahun terakhirnya.

src: He played professional baseball as an outfielder for 18 years from 1911 to 1928, including eight seasons in Major League Baseball with the Boston Red Sox (1915–1917), Detroit Tigers (1919–1921), St. Louis Browns (1922), and Cincinnati Reds (1924).
tgt: Dia bermain bisbol profesional sebagai outfielder selama 18 tahun dari tahun 1911 hingga 1928, termasuk delapan musim di Major League Baseball dengan Boston Red Sox (1915–1917), Detroit Tigers (1919–1921), St. Louis Browns (1922), dan Cincinnati Reds (1924).

src: He played the lead role in the sitcom "Rev.", which won the British Academy Television Award for best sitcom in 2011.
tgt: Dia memerankan peran utama dalam sitkom "Rev.", yang memenangkan British Academy Television Award untuk sitkom terbaik pada tahun 2011.

src: He plays guitar, pedal steel, piano, violin, dobro, hurdy-gurdy, mandolin, saxophone, the theremin and many other instruments.
tgt: Dia memainkan gitar, pedal steel, piano, biola, dobro, hurdy-gurdy, mandolin, saksofon, theremin, dan banyak instrumen lainnya.

src: He plays lead guitar and sings backing vocals for The Cars.
tgt: Dia memainkan gitar utama dan menyanyikan vokal latar untuk The Cars.

src: He previously served as the Mayor of Baltimore from 1999 to 2007, and was a councilman from the Third Councilmanic District in the northeast section of the city on the Baltimore City Council from 1991 to 1999.
tgt: Sebelumnya ia menjabat sebagai Wali Kota Baltimore dari tahun 1999 hingga 2007, dan pernah menjadi anggota dewan dari Distrik Dewan Ketiga di bagian timur laut kota dalam Dewan Kota Baltimore dari tahun 1991 hingga 1999.

src: He rarely appeared without Emu, a mute, highly aggressive arm-length puppet modelled on the Australian flightless emu bird.
tgt: Dia jarang muncul tanpa Emu, boneka setinggi lengan yang bisu dan sangat agresif yang dibuat berdasarkan burung emu Australia yang tidak bisa terbang.

src: He recorded his first solo album, "Marty Raybon", in 1995 on Sparrow Records.
tgt: Dia merekam album solo pertamanya, "Marty Raybon", pada tahun 1995 di Sparrow Records.

src: He represented Newtownards and County Kildare in the Irish House of Commons.
tgt: Dia mewakili Newtownards dan County Kildare di House of Commons Irlandia.

src: He represented Poland at the 2008 World Junior Championships in Bydgoszcz, Poland and took the gold medal in the javelin with a personal best throw of 78.01 metres.
tgt: Dia mewakili Polandia di Kejuaraan Junior Dunia 2008 di Bydgoszcz, Polandia dan meraih medali emas di nomor lembing dengan lemparan pribadi terbaik 78.01 meter.

src: He rose to fame in the 1990s as a cast member on "Saturday Night Live", then began a successful acting career in both film and television.
tgt: Dia meraih ketenaran pada tahun 1990-an sebagai anggota pemeran di "Saturday Night Live", kemudian memulai karier akting yang sukses di film dan televisi.

src: He rose to prominence with roles in two ensemble comedy-dramas"Dil Chahta Hai" (2001) and "Kal Ho Naa Ho" (2003).
tgt: Ia menanjak menjadi terkenal dengan peran dalam dua komedi-drama ensemble "Dil Chahta Hai" (2001) dan "Kal Ho Naa Ho" (2003).

src: He rounded out his career with the Los Angeles Raiders from 1984 to 1985 and the Cleveland Browns in 1986.
tgt: Ia mengakhiri kariernya dengan Los Angeles Raiders dari tahun 1984 hingga 1985 dan Cleveland Browns pada tahun 1986.

src: He sat as Member of Parliament for Callington and was also a composer.
tgt: Dia duduk sebagai Anggota Parlemen untuk Callington dan juga seorang komposer.

src: He served as assistant weaponeer on the "Enola Gay", which dropped the first atomic bomb on the city of Hiroshima, Japan on August 6, 1945.
tgt: Dia menjabat sebagai asisten penembak senjata di "Enola Gay", yang menjatuhkan bom atom pertama di kota Hiroshima, Jepang pada 6 Agustus 1945.

src: He served as regent and de facto monarch during the interregnum period when the royal succession of Mangareva was in doubt and after the death of the last royal heir became the last monarch of the island kingdom.
tgt: Ia menjabat sebagai regent dan monarki de facto selama periode interregnum ketika suksesi kerajaan Mangareva diragukan dan setelah kematian pewaris kerajaan terakhir menjadi monarki terakhir kerajaan pulau tersebut.

src: He served as the head football coach at Tempe State Teachers College, known at Arizona State Teachers College by 1929 and now called Arizona State University, compiling a career college football record of 25–17–4.
tgt: Ia menjabat sebagai kepala pelatih sepak bola di Tempe State Teachers College, yang dikenal sebagai Arizona State Teachers College pada tahun 1929 dan sekarang disebut Arizona State University, dengan mengumpulkan rekor sepak bola perguruan tinggi karier 25–17–4.

src: He served the chief executive officer and president of TransUnion from August 2007 to December 31, 2012, and Transunion Financing Corp. until December 31, 2012.
tgt: Ia melayani chief executive officer dan presiden TransUnion dari Agustus 2007 hingga 31 Desember 2012, dan Transunion Financing Corp. hingga 31 Desember 2012.

src: He spent thirteen seasons at Blackpool, with whom he was victorious in the famous FA Cup Final of 1953.
tgt: Dia menghabiskan tiga belas musim di Blackpool, bersama mereka ia meraih kemenangan di Final FA Cup yang terkenal pada tahun 1953.

src: He studied music at the Berklee College of Music.
tgt: Dia belajar musik di Berklee College of Music.

src: He succeeded Ecgfrith, the son of Offa; Ecgfrith only reigned for five months, and Coenwulf ascended to the throne in the same year that Offa died.
tgt: Ia menggantikan Ecgfrith, putra Offa; Ecgfrith hanya memerintah selama lima bulan, dan Coenwulf naik takhta pada tahun yang sama Offa meninggal.

src: He succeeded Sandra Froman in 2007, and was the organization's 59th President since it was founded in 1871.
tgt: Dia menggantikan Sandra Froman pada tahun 2007, dan merupakan Presiden ke-59 organisasi tersebut sejak didirikan pada tahun 1871.

src: He taught himself Yiddish at high school age and started writing Yiddish poetry as a teenager.
tgt: Dia belajar bahasa Yiddish sendiri saat SMA dan mulai menulis puisi Yiddish saat remaja.

src: He then commanded the 2nd Battalion of the 66th Regiment of Foot and, later, the 52nd Regiment of Foot at many of the battles of the Peninsular War.
tgt: Dia kemudian memimpin Batalion ke-2 dari Regimen ke-66 Kaki dan, kemudian, Regimen ke-52 Kaki dalam banyak pertempuran Perang Semenanjung.

src: He was Dutch Ambassador to England, Sweden and Venice.
tgt: Dia adalah Duta Besar Belanda untuk Inggris, Swedia, dan Venesia.

src: He was a cofounder of Scientific Games Corporation, a company which built computer systems to run state lotteries in the United States.
tgt: Dia adalah salah satu pendiri Scientific Games Corporation, sebuah perusahaan yang membangun sistem komputer untuk menjalankan lotere negara bagian di Amerika Serikat.

src: He was a cousin of the Israeli Communist Party leader Meir Vilner.
tgt: Dia adalah sepupu dari pemimpin Partai Komunis Israel, Meir Vilner.

src: He was a member of the Kansas House of Representatives from 2003 to 2008.
tgt: Dia adalah anggota House of Representatives Kansas dari tahun 2003 hingga 2008.

src: He was a nephew of South Vietnam's first president, Ngô Đình Diệm, and of Archbishop Ngô Đình Thục.
tgt: Dia adalah keponakan presiden pertama Vietnam Selatan, Ngô Đình Diệm, dan Uskup Agung Ngô Đình Thục.

src: He was a rapper before becoming involved in Martin O'Malley's first Mayoral campaign after meeting him in 1998.
tgt: Dia adalah seorang rapper sebelum terlibat dalam kampanye Walikota pertama Martin O'Malley setelah bertemu dengannya pada tahun 1998.

src: He was a resident of Manhattan for most of his adult life, establishing a residence in the upper east side area after 1945, when he was twenty-four.
tgt: Dia adalah penduduk Manhattan selama sebagian besar kehidupan dewasanya, mendirikan tempat tinggal di area upper east side setelah tahun 1945, ketika dia berusia dua puluh empat tahun.

src: He was also Croatian national javelin throw champion four times.
tgt: Dia juga merupakan juara lempar lembing nasional Kroasia sebanyak empat kali.

src: He was also a board member of corporations including Goldman Sachs, Procter & Gamble, and American Airlines, as well as an advisor to non-profits such as the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation and The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria.
tgt: Dia juga merupakan anggota dewan direksi perusahaan termasuk Goldman Sachs, Procter & Gamble, dan American Airlines, serta penasihat bagi organisasi nirlaba seperti Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation dan The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria.

src: He was also a foil instructor at a local Tampa fencing academy.
tgt: Dia juga seorang instruktur foil di akademi fencing lokal Tampa.

src: He was also known for his portrayal of Hollywood Montrose, a flamboyant window dresser in "Mannequin".
tgt: Dia juga dikenal karena perannya sebagai Hollywood Montrose, seorang penata etalase yang flamboyan dalam "Mannequin".

src: He was also nominated for an Emmy for his work on "Mad About You".
tgt: Dia juga dinominasikan untuk Emmy atas karyanya di "Mad About You".

src: He was also responsible for corporate marketing, strategic planning and corporate development for HSBC North America Holdings Inc. and had responsibility for the strategic management of credit cards throughout the HSBC Group.
tgt: Dia juga bertanggung jawab atas pemasaran korporat, perencanaan strategis, dan pengembangan korporat untuk HSBC North America Holdings Inc. dan memiliki tanggung jawab atas manajemen strategis kartu kredit di seluruh HSBC Group.

src: He was an avid amateur botanist who worked in a pharmacy, which he had partial ownership in until his death.
tgt: Dia adalah seorang ahli botani amatir yang antusias yang bekerja di sebuah apotek, yang kepemilikannya sebagian dia miliki hingga kematiannya.

src: He was an expert witness in Deborah Lipstadt's successful defence in the civil libel suit brought against her by David Irving.
tgt: Dia adalah saksi ahli dalam pembelaan Deborah Lipstadt yang berhasil dalam gugatan pencemaran nama baik perdata yang diajukan David Irving terhadapnya.

src: He was appointed Lieutenant China, which he held for twenty-one years after which he was made Captain China.
tgt: Dia diangkat menjadi Letnan China, yang dia pegang selama dua puluh satu tahun setelah itu dia diangkat menjadi Kapten China.

src: He was best friends with C. Walton Lillehei and they worked together at the University of Minnesota.
tgt: Dia adalah sahabat C. Walton Lillehei dan mereka bekerja bersama di University of Minnesota.

src: He was born Ying Zheng (嬴政 ) or Zhao Zheng (趙政 ), a prince of the state of Qin.
tgt: Ia lahir dengan nama Ying Zheng (嬴政) atau Zhao Zheng (趙政), seorang pangeran dari negara Qin.

src: He was born in Windsor, Ontario.
tgt: Dia lahir di Windsor, Ontario.

src: He was chosen to the parliament in the 2015 parliamentary election with 2140 votes.
tgt: Dia terpilih ke parlemen dalam pemilihan parlemen 2015 dengan 2140 suara.

src: He was developed in the early 1990s and made his first public appearance at the 1995 Pro Bowl as a Team NFL Hero.
tgt: Ia dikembangkan pada awal 1990-an dan membuat penampilan publik pertamanya di Pro Bowl 1995 sebagai Team NFL Hero.

src: He was drafted by the Chicago Cubs with the 30th pick in the 1st round of 2017 Major League Baseball draft.
tgt: Dia direkrut oleh Chicago Cubs dengan pilihan ke-30 di babak 1 draf Major League Baseball 2017.

src: He was drafted by the Seattle Mariners in the first round, 27th pick overall, of the 2009 Major League Baseball Draft.
tgt: Dia direkrut oleh Seattle Mariners di putaran pertama, pilihan ke-27 secara keseluruhan, dalam Major League Baseball Draft 2009.

src: He was married to Elisabeth Berenberg (1749–1822), the only heir of the Berenberg banking family.
tgt: Dia menikah dengan Elisabeth Berenberg (1749–1822), satu-satunya pewaris keluarga perbankan Berenberg.

src: He was nominated to be a commissioner by President George W. Bush on April 30, 2001, and was confirmed on May 25, 2001.
tgt: Dia dinominasikan untuk menjadi komisaris oleh Presiden George W. Bush pada 30 April 2001, dan dikonfirmasi pada 25 Mei 2001.

src: He was one of the active filmmaker to serve earthquake victims in different part of Nepal.
tgt: Dia adalah salah satu pembuat film aktif yang melayani korban gempa di berbagai bagian Nepal.

src: He was one of the longest tenured active coaches in NCAA Division I FBS and, at the time of his retirement, was the winningest active coach at that level.
tgt: Dia adalah salah satu pelatih aktif dengan masa jabatan terlama di NCAA Division I FBS dan, pada saat pensiunnya, adalah pelatih aktif dengan rekor kemenangan terbanyak di tingkat tersebut.

src: He was only 26 years old when his first statue, "Sarah Winnemucca," a Paiute activist in Nevada, was dedicated in the Hall in 2005, making him the youngest artist to ever be represented in the Hall.
tgt: Dia baru berusia 26 tahun ketika patung pertamanya, "Sarah Winnemucca," seorang aktivis Paiute di Nevada, didedikasikan di Hall pada tahun 2005, menjadikannya seniman termuda yang pernah diwakili di Hall.

src: He was professor of astronomical observation technique at the University of Groningen from 1968 to 1988.
tgt: Beliau adalah profesor teknik observasi astronomi di University of Groningen dari tahun 1968 hingga 1988.

src: He was promoted to command a light infantry demi-brigade at the Fleurus in 1794.
tgt: Dia dipromosikan untuk memimpin demi-brigade infanteri ringan di Fleurus pada tahun 1794.

src: He was raised in Detroit, Michigan.
tgt: Dia dibesarkan di Detroit, Michigan.

src: He was responsible for the arrest of Toussaint Louverture.
tgt: Dia bertanggung jawab atas penangkapan Toussaint Louverture.

src: He was sentenced in 2000 to three consecutive life terms without the possibility of parole, and is serving that sentence at the ADX Florence supermax prison near Florence, Colorado.
tgt: Dia dijatuhi hukuman pada tahun 2000 dengan tiga hukuman seumur hidup berturut-turut tanpa kemungkinan pembebasan bersyarat, dan sedang menjalani hukuman tersebut di penjara supermax ADX Florence dekat Florence, Colorado.

src: He was the Republican nominee for the U.S. Senate in 2006, finishing third with 9.6%, behind incumbent Senator Joe Lieberman, who won with 49.7% and Democrat Ned Lamont, who took 39.7%.
tgt: Dia adalah calon Republik untuk Senat A.S. pada tahun 2006, finis ketiga dengan 9,6%, di belakang Senator petahana Joe Lieberman, yang menang dengan 49,7% dan Demokrat Ned Lamont, yang meraih 39,7%.

src: He was the author/editor of the first pharmacy textbook published in America.
tgt: Dia adalah penulis/editor buku teks farmasi pertama yang diterbitkan di Amerika.

src: He was the brother of actor Noah Beery Sr. and uncle of actor Noah Beery Jr.
tgt: Dia adalah saudara dari aktor Noah Beery Sr. dan paman dari aktor Noah Beery Jr.

src: He was the first African American named head coach of a varsity sports team in any Western New York suburban school district.
tgt: Dia adalah orang Afrika-Amerika pertama yang menjabat sebagai kepala pelatih tim olahraga tingkat sekolah menengah di distrik sekolah pinggiran kota Western New York mana pun.

src: He was the first Premier of Tasmania to have been born in the 20th century.
tgt: Dia adalah Perdana Menteri Tasmania pertama yang lahir di abad ke-20.

src: He was the first Russian composer whose music made a lasting impression internationally, bolstered by his appearances as a guest conductor in Europe and the United States.
tgt: Dia adalah komposer Rusia pertama yang musiknya memberikan kesan abadi secara internasional, didukung oleh penampilannya sebagai konduktor tamu di Eropa dan Amerika Serikat.

src: He was the first faculty member elected to serve as president of the University Senate.
tgt: Dia adalah anggota fakultas pertama yang terpilih untuk menjabat sebagai presiden Senat Universitas.

src: He was the founder of the now-defunct company Global World Media, a maker of legal intoxicants, Cheyene developed several alternative medicine products, including "Herbal Ecstacy ," an ephedra-based alternative to the drug MDMA, commonly known as "ecstasy."
tgt: Dia adalah pendiri perusahaan Global World Media yang kini sudah tidak beroperasi, sebuah produsen zat psikoaktif legal, Cheyene mengembangkan beberapa produk pengobatan alternatif, termasuk "Herbal Ecstacy," alternatif berbasis ephedra untuk obat MDMA, yang umum dikenal sebagai "ecstasy."

src: He was the great-great-great-grandson of Henrietta Butler, Countess of Grantham (wife of Henry de Nassau d'Auverquerque, 1st Earl of Grantham), second daughter of Thomas Butler, Earl of Ossory and 1st Baron Butler, whose second daughter Lady Henrietta de Nassau d'Auverquerque married William Clavering-Cowper, 2nd Earl Cowper.
tgt: Dia adalah cicit dari Henrietta Butler, Countess of Grantham (istri Henry de Nassau d'Auverquerque, 1st Earl of Grantham), putri kedua Thomas Butler, Earl of Ossory dan 1st Baron Butler, yang putri keduanya Lady Henrietta de Nassau d'Auverquerque menikahi William Clavering-Cowper, 2nd Earl Cowper.

src: He was the head coach at The Citadel from 1960 to 1967 and is perhaps most notable as Pat Conroy's coach at the school during the season memorialized in Conroy's memoir "My Losing Season".
tgt: Dia adalah pelatih kepala di The Citadel dari tahun 1960 hingga 1967 dan mungkin paling terkenal sebagai pelatih Pat Conroy di sekolah selama musim yang dikenang dalam memoar Conroy "My Losing Season".

src: He was the son of James Boreel, younger brother of the fifth Baronet.
tgt: Dia adalah putra James Boreel, adik laki-laki Baronet kelima.

src: He was the son of the carpenter Robert Gillow, the founder of Gillows of Lancaster and London, a successful cabinet-making firm.
tgt: Dia adalah putra tukang kayu Robert Gillow, pendiri Gillows of Lancaster and London, sebuah perusahaan pembuatan lemari yang sukses.

src: He was the son of Æthelwald Moll and Æthelthryth and possibly became king while still a child after Alhred was deposed.
tgt: Dia adalah putra Æthelwald Moll dan Æthelthryth dan mungkin menjadi raja saat masih kecil setelah Alhred digulingkan.

src: He was the youngest and longest surviving signatory of the Israeli Declaration of Independence in 1948.
tgt: Dia adalah penandatangan Deklarasi Kemerdekaan Israel pada tahun 1948 yang termuda dan paling lama bertahan.

src: He won a championship and an NBA Finals Most Valuable Player Award in his rookie season, and won four more championships with the Lakers during the 1980s.
tgt: Dia memenangkan kejuaraan dan penghargaan Pemain Paling Berharga NBA Finals di musim debutnya, dan memenangkan empat kejuaraan lagi bersama Lakers selama tahun 1980-an.

src: He won a record 23 tennis Majors including 8 Grand Slam singles titles and before the Open Era a record 15 Pro Slam titles and a record 35 Major finals overall.
tgt: Dia memenangkan rekor 23 turnamen tenis Mayor, termasuk 8 gelar tunggal Grand Slam, dan sebelum Era Terbuka rekor 15 gelar Pro Slam serta rekor 35 final Mayor secara keseluruhan.

src: He won the Pro Grand Slam in 1963.
tgt: Dia memenangkan Pro Grand Slam pada tahun 1963.

src: He won the Tony Award for Best Actor in a Musical in 2000 for his performance in "Kiss Me, Kate".
tgt: Dia memenangkan Tony Award untuk Aktor Terbaik dalam Musikal pada tahun 2000 atas penampilannya di "Kiss Me, Kate".

src: He worked as a forced laborer in the Heinkel factory in Oranienburg until October 1943.
tgt: Dia bekerja sebagai pekerja paksa di pabrik Heinkel di Oranienburg hingga Oktober 1943.

src: He's worshipped as a deadly professional, but when he falls in love with one such gifted boy, Masato, everything changes.
tgt: Dia dipuja sebagai profesional mematikan, tetapi ketika dia jatuh cinta pada seorang anak berbakat seperti Masato, segalanya berubah.

src: Headquarters are in Niles, Illinois, and they have an annual catalog circulation exceeding 50 million.
tgt: Kantor pusatnya berada di Niles, Illinois, dan mereka memiliki sirkulasi katalog tahunan melebihi 50 juta.

src: Heard 'Em Say
tgt: Dengar Mereka Bilang

src: Heartbeat Records
tgt: Heartbeat Records

src: Heartist
tgt: Ahli jantung

src: Heathrow Airport
tgt: Bandara Heathrow

src: Heathrow Airport (also known as London Heathrow) (IATA: LHR, ICAO: EGLL) is a major international airport in London, United Kingdom.
tgt: Bandara Heathrow (juga dikenal sebagai London Heathrow) (IATA: LHR, ICAO: EGLL) adalah bandara internasional utama di London, Britania Raya.

src: Helen Zahavi
tgt: Helen Zahavi

src: Helen Zahavi (born 1966) is an English novelist and screenwriter born and educated in London.
tgt: Helen Zahavi (lahir 1966) adalah novelis dan penulis skenario Inggris yang lahir dan dididik di London.

src: Hempfest has also in recent years attracted such well-known performers as Fishbone (2002), The Kottonmouth Kings (2004), Rehab (2006), and Pato Banton (2007) to its five stages spread throughout Myrtle Edwards Park and Elliott Bay Park, on Seattle's waterfront.
tgt: Hempfest juga dalam beberapa tahun terakhir telah menarik penampil terkenal seperti Fishbone (2002), The Kottonmouth Kings (2004), Rehab (2006), dan Pato Banton (2007) ke lima panggungnya yang tersebar di Myrtle Edwards Park dan Elliott Bay Park, di tepi air Seattle.

src: Henny Koch
tgt: Henny Koch

src: Henriad
tgt: Henriad

src: Henrietta Ponsonby, Countess of Bessborough
tgt: Henrietta Ponsonby, Countess of Bessborough

src: Henrietta Ponsonby, Countess of Bessborough (16 June 1761 – 11 November 1821), born Lady Henrietta Frances Spencer (generally called Harriet), was the wife of Frederick Ponsonby, 3rd Earl of Bessborough, and mother of the notorious Lady Caroline Lamb.
tgt: Henrietta Ponsonby, Countess of Bessborough (16 Juni 1761 – 11 November 1821), lahir sebagai Lady Henrietta Frances Spencer (umumnya dipanggil Harriet), adalah istri Frederick Ponsonby, Earl of Bessborough ke-3, dan ibu dari Lady Caroline Lamb yang terkenal.

src: Henry Cabot Lodge Jr.
tgt: Henry Cabot Lodge Jr.

src: Henry Cabot Lodge Jr. (July 5, 1902 – February 27, 1985) sometimes referred to as Henry Cabot Lodge II, was a Republican United States Senator from Massachusetts and a United States ambassador.
tgt: Henry Cabot Lodge Jr. (5 Juli 1902 – 27 Februari 1985), kadang-kadang disebut Henry Cabot Lodge II, adalah Senator Republik Amerika Serikat dari Massachusetts dan duta besar Amerika Serikat.

src: Henry Gwyn Jeffreys Moseley (23 November 1887 – 10 August 1915) was an English physicist, whose contribution to the science of physics was the justification from physical laws of the previous empirical and chemical concept of the atomic number.
tgt: Henry Gwyn Jeffreys Moseley (23 November 1887 – 10 August 1915) adalah seorang fisikawan Inggris, yang kontribusinya pada ilmu fisika adalah justifikasi dari hukum-hukum fisika terhadap konsep nomor atom yang sebelumnya bersifat empiris dan kimia.

src: Henry Louis Mencken (September 12, 1880 – January 29, 1956) was an American journalist, satirist, cultural critic and scholar of American English.
tgt: Henry Louis Mencken (12 September 1880 – 29 Januari 1956) adalah seorang jurnalis, satirist, kritikus budaya, dan sarjana bahasa Inggris Amerika dari Amerika.

src: Henry Moseley
tgt: Henry Moseley

src: Henry V (1944 film)
tgt: Henry V (film 1944)

src: Henry V Events
tgt: Acara Henry V

src: Henry V is a 1944 British Technicolor film adaptation of William Shakespeare's play of the same name.
tgt: Henry V adalah adaptasi film Technicolor Inggris tahun 1944 dari drama William Shakespeare dengan nama yang sama.

src: Henry V is a full-service communications agency specializing in live events and experience marketing.
tgt: Henry V adalah agensi komunikasi layanan penuh yang berspesialisasi dalam acara langsung dan pemasaran pengalaman.

src: Henry V is headquartered in Portland, Oregon.
tgt: Henry V berkantor pusat di Portland, Oregon.

src: Her 1974 work "Pilgrim at Tinker Creek" won the 1975 Pulitzer Prize for General Nonfiction.
tgt: Karya tahun 1974-nya, "Pilgrim at Tinker Creek", memenangkan Hadiah Pulitzer untuk Nonfiksi Umum tahun 1975.

src: Her 2015 play "Raising Agents", celebrating the centenary of the Women's Institutes, was one of the two shows of Mikron's 150-venue 2015 tour; in writing it she worked with the National Federation of Women's Institutes and visited meetings of several WIs.
tgt: Drama tahun 2015-nya, "Raising Agents", yang merayakan seratus tahun Women's Institutes, adalah salah satu dari dua pertunjukan dalam tur 150 lokasi Mikron pada tahun 2015; dalam penulisannya ia bekerja dengan National Federation of Women's Institutes dan mengunjungi pertemuan beberapa WI.

src: Her credits include "Old Joy", "Wendy and Lucy", "Meek's Cutoff", "Night Moves" and "Certain Women".
tgt: Kreditnya meliputi "Old Joy", "Wendy and Lucy", "Meek's Cutoff", "Night Moves", dan "Certain Women".

src: Her debut album "You" was produced by Grammy Award winner Jesse Harris.
tgt: Album debutnya "You" diproduksi oleh pemenang Grammy Jesse Harris.

src: Her debut feature film 'Pomegranates and Myrrh picked up 10 international awards, sold worldwide and was released theatrically and screened at over 80 international festivals.
tgt: Film fitur debutnya, 'Pomegranates and Myrrh', meraih 10 penghargaan internasional, terjual di seluruh dunia, dan tayang di bioskop serta diputar di lebih dari 80 festival internasional.

src: Her father, John Spencer, 1st Earl Spencer, was a great-grandson of John Churchill, 1st Duke of Marlborough.
tgt: Ayahnya, John Spencer, 1st Earl Spencer, adalah cicit dari John Churchill, 1st Duke of Marlborough.

src: She discovered that Goldman Sachs did not have any policy on conflict of interest when it advised El Paso Corporation on selling itself to Kinder Morgan, a company in which Goldman Sachs owned a US$4 billion stake, and with several former Goldman Sachs employees who had previously worked for Kinder Morgan on the El Paso team.

src: She had a column with business content on the evening news program SKAI with Nikos Evaggelatos and she was the anchor of the daily morning news program.

src: She had a successful career as one of Irish best known and most photographed models for a number of years before opening the Andrea Roche Modelling Agency.

src: She has also appeared in one starring theater role, numerous television commercials and directed a piece of the motion picture "If These Walls Could Talk" in 1996 and some of her music videos of the Geffen-era in late 1980s and in early 1990s.
tgt: Dia juga telah tampil dalam satu peran utama di teater, banyak iklan televisi, dan menyutradarai film "If These Walls Could Talk" pada tahun 1996 serta beberapa video musiknya pada era Geffen di akhir tahun 1980-an dan awal tahun 1990-an.

src: She has also been published as Suzy Pizzuti.
tgt: Dia juga telah menerbitkan diri sebagai Suzy Pizzuti.

src: She has also written for "The Washington Monthly, Ladies Home Journal, Good Housekeeping, Self", and "Shape".
tgt: Dia juga menulis untuk "The Washington Monthly, Ladies Home Journal, Good Housekeeping, Self", dan "Shape".

src: She has been credited with having trained Patrick in dance, leading to his starring role in "Dirty Dancing" in 1987.

src: She has choreographed Hindi and Marathi films like, Happy New Year (2014), Julie 2 (2016), Natarang (2010), Kuni Mulgi Deta Ka Mulgi (2012), and Mitwaa (2015).

src: She is a regular contributor to "The Huffington Post".
tgt: Dia adalah kontributor tetap di "The Huffington Post".

src: She is also a three-time Olivier Award winner, winning Best Supporting Performance in 1988 (for Multiple roles) and Best Actress for "The Unexpected Man" (1999) and "Honour" (2004).
tgt: Dia juga pemenang tiga kali Olivier Award, memenangkan Best Supporting Performance pada tahun 1988 (untuk Peran Ganda) dan Best Actress untuk "The Unexpected Man" (1999) dan "Honour" (2004).

src: She is also the 2011 recipient of the Research in Information Science Award from the American Association of Information Science and Technology.
tgt: Dia juga penerima Research in Information Science Award tahun 2011 dari American Association of Information Science and Technology.

src: She is also the founder and former CEO of Buzzcar, a peer-to-peer car sharing service, acquired by Drivy.
tgt: Dia juga pendiri dan mantan CEO Buzzcar, layanan berbagi mobil antar-rekan, yang diakuisisi oleh Drivy.

src: She is best known for her title role in the 1985 film "The Journey of Natty Gann" and the 1989 teen comedy, "Dream a Little Dream".
tgt: Dia paling dikenal karena peran utamanya dalam film tahun 1985 "The Journey of Natty Gann" dan komedi remaja tahun 1989, "Dream a Little Dream".

src: She is best known for twice (2001 and 2005) winning the gold medal at the Mediterranean Games in the women's 1500 metres.

src: The 6.5×68mm rebated rim bottlenecked centerfire rifle cartridge (also known as the 6.5×68mm RWS, 6.5×68mm Schüler, or the 6.5×68mm Von Hofe Express) and its sister cartridge the 8×68mm S were developed in the 1930s by August Schüler from the "August Schüler Waffenfabrik, Suhl, Germany" as magnum hunting cartridges that would just fit and function in standard-sized Mauser 98 bolt-action rifles.

src: The 8×68mm S rebated rim bottlenecked centerfire rifle cartridge (the S denoting it is intended for 8.2 mm (.323 in) groove diameter bullets) and its necked-down sister cartridge, the 6.5×68mm (no S, or other modifier required), were developed in the 1930s by August Schüler of the "August Schüler Waffenfabrik, Suhl, Germany" as magnum hunting cartridges that would just fit and function in standard-sized Mauser 98 bolt-action rifles.
tgt: Peluru senapan centerfire berlekuk (S) 8×68mm dengan rim rebated dan bottlenecked (S menunjukkan bahwa peluru ini ditujukan untuk peluru dengan diameter alur 8.2 mm (.323 in)) dan saudara pelurunya yang dikecilkan, 6.5×68mm (tanpa S, atau modifikasi lain diperlukan), dikembangkan pada tahun 1930-an oleh August Schüler dari "August Schüler Waffenfabrik, Suhl, Germany" sebagai peluru berburu magnum yang akan muat dan berfungsi dalam senapan bolt-action Mauser 98 berukuran standar.
